name: Raneto
tagline: is an open source Knowledgebase platform that uses static Markdown files to power your Knowledgebase.
description: Raneto - is an open source Knowledgebase platform that uses static Markdown files to power your Knowledgebase.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/raneto:0.18.1@sha256:a460ac8aa367ffe0f6af7474148eb66bd8bb08508b4c78a3d65b18f98b7670e4
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
